content: Go UDP close semantics: conn.Close() from another goroutine makes blocked ReadFromUDP return an error; check with errors.Is(err, net.ErrClosed) (Go 1.16+) instead of string matching; net.ErrClosed is the canonical sentinel. Known platform nuances where Close does not unblock a concurrent read (documented discussions). Also: if the ReadFromUDP buffer is smaller than the datagram, the excess is SILENTLY discarded (recvfrom semantics, no error, MSG_TRUNC not surfaced by Go) - read buffer must be sized to max datagram (65507 for IPv4) .
